coverage_note: State and local public employees, including public school employees, under SDCL chapter 3-18 (Public Employees' Unions), administered by the Department of Labor and Regulation. Board of Regents employees (other than at the schools for the deaf and blind), court employees and others listed in 3-18-1 are excluded.
quote_normalization: quote_binding exact-substring is checked after Unicode NFC and collapsing every run of whitespace (including no-break space) to one space, in both the quote and the text extracted from the captured bytes (HTML: BeautifulSoup get_text; PDF: pdftotext)

governing_statute.quote: Public employees shall have the right to form and join labor or employee organizations, and shall have the right not to form and join such organizations.

labor_board.value: South Dakota Department of Labor and Regulation (unit determinations, unfair practice complaints, impasse intervention); there is no separate labor board
labor_board.quote: the Department of Labor and Regulation or any person designated by it shall, at the request of any of the parties, investigate such question and, after a hearing if requested by any party, rule on the definition of the appropriate representation unit.

ulp_limitation_period.value: Sixty days after the alleged unfair practice, or sixty days after the complainant should have known of it, filed with the Department of Labor and Regulation
ulp_limitation_period.quote: shall be filed with the Department of Labor and Regulation within sixty days after the alleged commission of an unfair labor practice occurs or within sixty days after the complainant should have known of the offense.

who_may_bargain.value: Persons employed by the state, its political subdivisions, public schools, and public authorities, commissions and boards, excluding elected officials and board members, administrators and supervisors (other than school administrators), part-time students, short-term temporaries, National Guard, court and legislative employees, and most Board of Regents employees
who_may_bargain.quote: The term, public employee, as used in this chapter means any person holding a position by appointment or employment in the government of the State of South Dakota or in the government of any one or more of the political subdivisions thereof, or in the service of the public schools, or in the service of any authority, commission, or board, or any other branch of the public service.

scope_of_bargaining.value: Rates of pay, wages, hours of employment and other conditions of employment, plus grievance procedures; Board of Regents faculty and exempt-staff raises are limited to listed purposes
scope_of_bargaining.quote: shall be the exclusive representatives of all employees in such unit for the purpose of representation in respect to rates of pay, wages, hours of employment, or other conditions of employment

impasse_procedure.value: Either party may ask the Department of Labor and Regulation to intervene under SDCL 60-10-1 to 60-10-3, within ten days after a written impasse declaration; the parties may agree on another procedure
impasse_procedure.quote: In case of impasse or failure to reach an agreement in negotiations conducted under the provisions of this chapter, either party may request the Department of Labor and Regulation to intervene under the provisions of §§ 60-10-1 to 60-10-3 , inclusive.

agency_fee_status.value: Not enforceable against nonconsenting public employees after Janus v. AFSCME Council 31 (2018); employees also have a statutory right not to join
agency_fee_status.quote: For these reasons, States and public-sector unions may no longer extract agency fees from nonconsenting employees.

dfr_forum.value: Department of Labor and Regulation, through an unfair practice complaint against the employee organization; the statute does not name a duty of fair representation, and the department's treatment of such claims rests on decisions not captured
dfr_forum.quote: It is an unfair practice for an employee organization or its agents to: (1) Restrain or coerce an employee in the exercise of the rights guaranteed by this chapter.
